directAnswer: Write to connect@gatisdesign.com or fill in the form - you will get a reply within one business day. A short description works best: what is not working right now, what the goal is and by which date it has to be done. After a 20-30 minute call I send a proposal with a fixed price and timeline. I ask for a budget range in the form on purpose - it saves time for both sides.
metaDescription: Write what needs solving and I reply within one business day. After a call you get a proposal with a price and a timeline. connect@gatisdesign.com, Riga.

sections.heading: What to write so the reply is useful
body: The more specific the description, the more specific the reply. No technical specification is needed: five concrete lines are worth more than two pages of general words.
bullets: What is not working right now: the website brings no leads, the brand looks dated, the team spends hours on manual work.
What the goal is: more leads, a new market, less routine, visibility in AI answers.
What already exists: a current website, a logo, copy, photos, a CRM.
The deadline and the budget range.
A link to your site and to one competitor's site that you like.

sections.heading: I reply within one business day
body: I work alone, so I read every request myself. You will get a reply within one business day - even when the reply is “this is not my kind of work, but I know who does it better”.
If nothing has arrived within two days, check your spam folder and write again directly to connect@gatisdesign.com.

sections.heading: What happens after your request
body: No multi-stage sales funnels: three steps from your message to a clear proposal.

steps.title: Reply
steps.text: I read the description and reply with the first questions, or offer a time for a call right away. If the project is not a fit for me, I say so immediately, not a week later.

steps.title: Call
steps.text: A phone or video call. We talk about the problem, not about my experience. After the call it is usually clear whether the answer is a new website, a brand, automation or three changes to the existing site.

steps.title: Proposal
steps.text: A written proposal with the scope, a fixed price and dated deadlines, no hidden line items. If you agree, we start with a 50% advance payment.

sections.heading: Request form
body: The completed form goes straight to my inbox. Nobody else reads it, and your description is never published anywhere.
I ask about the budget range on purpose: if you have 800 EUR but the solution costs 6000 EUR, that is worth knowing in the first minute, not after the third call.

sections.heading: Contact details
body: Email connect@gatisdesign.com is the fastest way.
I am based in Riga and work remotely with clients in Latvia, Estonia, Lithuania and the USA. Correspondence and calls in Latvian, English or Russian.

sections.heading: What I do not do
body: This is not arrogance but time-saving: there are projects where I will not be the best choice.
bullets: I do not take projects where the only criterion is the lowest price. If the choice is made from a table of three quotes, you will find someone cheaper.
I do not take work that was due yesterday. Design made in a hurry looks like design made in a hurry.
I do not work without access to the person who makes the decisions. If every sentence has to be approved by a committee of five, the process will stall.
I do not start work with the brief “make something beautiful”. If there is no goal, there is nothing to measure.
I do not sell hours. I sell a result with a fixed price and a timeline.

faq.q: How long does a reply take?
faq.a: No longer than one business day. If you write on a Friday evening, the reply comes on Monday. If nothing has arrived within two days, the message most likely landed in spam - write again directly to connect@gatisdesign.com.
No. The first call, 20-30 minutes, is free and without obligation. You only pay for the work that starts after the proposal is approved.

50% on agreement, 50% on delivery. Invoices are due in 5 business days and are issued without VAT. The price in the proposal is fixed: if the scope changes along the way, we agree on it in writing before I continue.

faq.q: Do you work with clients abroad?
faq.a: Yes. Clients are in Latvia, Estonia, Lithuania and the USA. The work is remote, correspondence and calls in Latvian, English or Russian. I schedule calls around the client's time zone.

faq.q: Can you take over a project that is already under way?
faq.a: Yes, and it happens often. Before I agree, I assess what has been done: code quality, hosting, access, licenses. Sometimes it is cheaper to finish the existing work, sometimes to rebuild from scratch. I tell you honestly which option is better for you, even when the other one would pay me more.

heroLede: Tell me what is not working right now and when it has to be ready. I reply within one business day, and after the first call you get a fixed quote with a timeline.
